Artifacts.Description: Outlines the module's learning topics covering complex SQL queries, including JOIN types (INNER, LEFT, and others), and WHERE clause filtering with comparison and logical operators, serving as a roadmap for learners and instructors to understand what concepts will be taught and in what order.
